title: Apache Kudu
summary: Apache Kudu is a column-oriented data store within the Apache Hadoop ecosystem, designed for OLAP workloads and real-time analytics on fast data. It provides a relational data model with columnar on-disk storage, differentiating it from schemaless systems like HBase. Kudu integrates with Hadoop processing frameworks and supports key-indexed record lookup and mutation, originally developed internally at Cloudera before its open-source release in 2016.

mechanisms.title: Columnar On-Disk Storage
mechanisms.explanation: Kudu stores data on disk in a column-oriented format, which differs from the row-oriented or Bigtable-style storage used by HBase. This design is optimized for analytical query patterns typical of OLAP workloads.

mechanisms.title: Relational Data Model with Key-Indexed Operations
mechanisms.explanation: Kudu employs a more traditional relational data model compared to the schemaless design of HBase. It supports key-indexed record lookup and mutation, enabling real-time updates alongside analytical processing.
